title: Connecting law for normalized Cech comparison morphisms
statement: Let X be a scheme and U an open cover. Given comparison morphisms from Cech cohomology to sheaf cohomology in every degree, for every sectionwise-surjective short exact coefficient sequence the comparison morphisms satisfy the connecting-map identity.

proof.text: For a sectionwise-surjective short exact sequence, the Cech complexes are short exact. Horseshoe resolutions and naturality of homology boundaries identify the Cech and sheaf connecting morphisms, yielding the displayed identity.

theorem cechComparisonSystem_comparison_connecting
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (comparison : ∀ q, TopCat.Sheaf.cechCohomologyFunctor U q ⟶
      Sheaf.functorH (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) q)
    (q : ℕ) (T : ShortComplex
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (hT : T.ShortExact)
    (hg : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      Function.Surjective (T.g.hom.app (op (⨅ l, U (y l))))) :
    TopCat.Sheaf.cechδ U hT hg q ≫ (comparison (q + 1)).app T.X₁ =
      (comparison q).app T.X₃ ≫ Sheaf.functorHδ hT q
